changelog.title: SteamLite 10.0.3 - Profiles and an anti-cheat fix
items: Profiles: switch between Steam accounts from your picture in the title bar, or add another one with Sign in with Steam
A new profile opens on a full-screen page to set up its SteamLite account, with message and notification switches
Games with an anti-cheat are no longer counted as closed when their launcher quits
Message notification switches now belong to each profile

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.3 Released - Profiles and an anti-cheat fix
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.3 is out. You can now switch between Steam accounts, or add another one, from your picture in the title bar, and a new profile opens on a setup page for its messages and notifications. Games with an anti-cheat are no longer counted as closed when their launcher quits.

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.2 Released - More motion, achievement pictures
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.2 is out. Achievement pictures load again, and game page tabs, the Library filters and other choices now have a highlight that glides between them. Buttons spring when pressed and page sections rise in one after another.

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.1 Released - Fixes and polish
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.1 is out. It makes page changes smoother, removes a clipped glow under the selected filter chips and game tabs, fixes spacing in Settings, and fixes a few small bugs.

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.0 Released - A new engine and a new interface
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.0 is out. It runs on a new, lighter engine with a completely rebuilt interface, and Messages are back with notifications, photos and GIFs, and block and unblock. Drops, the shop, the trophy room, events, wishlist and sales, inventory and the tools hub are not in this version yet and will return in the new design.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 is out - you are on the stable release now
news.content: The 9.0 betas are over: 9.0.0 is the stable release. Install it from the SteamLite Updater (Channel: Stable) or the releases page. XP, levels and SteamLite achievements are back in 9.0.0.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 8 - Couch mode polish
news.content: Beta 8 adds smooth transitions into and out of couch mode, and the couch Play button now follows the same launch tracking as the normal Play button: Loading..., Stopping..., and Stop only once the game is really running.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 7 - Couch mode
news.content: Beta 7 adds Couch mode: a fullscreen launcher you can drive entirely from a gamepad. Big covers in rows, a hero panel with the game you are on, A to open a game page (Play, Favorite, Status, Rating and tabs for Overview, Achievements, Screenshots and News), B to go back, X to favourite and Y for music. Open it from the controller button in the top bar or press Ctrl+Shift+G.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 6 - Spotify now playing
news.content: Beta 6 adds Spotify to SteamLite: a small player in the top bar shows the song and album art with play / pause / next / previous, and clicking it opens a full player with a seekable progress bar. No login is needed. Switch it on in Settings > Behaviour > Now playing (it is off by default).

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Beta 5 - Discord presence upgrade
news.content: Discord Rich Presence is better: your game card has the game art, a correct timer, achievement progress, your streak and View on Steam / Get SteamLite buttons. Not in a game, it shows which page you are on. You can turn each part off or hide game names under Settings > Behaviour > Discord presence, and it now reconnects by itself.
